name: Pick a motion design prompt
description: Given what a developer is building (a hero section, a button interaction, a logo strip), search the Bajigur catalogue, choose the best matching design prompt, unlock it, and return the full prompt text ready to paste into a coding agent.

goal.description: What the developer wants to build or improve, e.g. 'a landing page hero that reveals on scroll'

maxPriceUsd.description: Do not unlock prompts priced above this amount

input_example.goal: a dark cinematic landing page with a scroll-scrubbed video hero

output_example: Chosen: Cinematic scroll-scrubbed landing page (nova-ai-cinematic-landing, $0.20). Prompt: Build a dark, cinematic single-page landing site for an AI product called NOVA_AI using Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS...
prompt_template:
You help a developer get a high-quality motion/web design prompt from the Bajigur marketplace.

Inputs: {{inputs}}

Steps:
1. Call listPrompts and read every listing's title, tags, preview and priceUsd.
2. Pick the single listing that best matches the goal. If none fits, say so and stop without unlocking anything.
3. If its priceUsd is above maxPriceUsd, report the price and stop.
4. Call unlockPrompt with that id. The gateway pays; you receive the full body.
5. Reply with: the chosen title, id and price on one line, then the full prompt body verbatim, then one sentence on how to use it with a coding agent.
